correctness.rationale: Exact computation spans all 45 states and 990 unordered state pairs; grounded 44-by-44 inverse uses Fraction and checks L0*B=I. Every 120-element S5 action is verified to preserve graph adjacency and all 17 pair-orbits are enumerated. All 17 resistance values are different, which forces full-automorphism orbit separation. BFS checks distances and a separately derived Laplacian characteristic polynomial confirms the Kirchhoff-index checksum. Finite domain and all quantifiers are explicit.

value.rationale: The 2-token graph of Petersen is a canonical exclusion-state graph. A single scalar electrical metric completely identifies 17 pair-orbits; the further example where graph distance two has smaller resistance than graph distance one demonstrates independent geometry. This meaningful complete finite classification supplies a reproducible exact benchmark; neither arbitrary slicing nor a known-table recomputation is asserted.
